disk_strategy: Keep one official sourcedata.zip with full official MD5/SHA256 validation, upload immutable archive to R2, audit SETs plus one FDT at a time or stream member data; do not hold full raw extraction together with archive. Retain source-relative member paths and per-member CRC/SHA receipts. Processed archive remains catalogue-only. No paid compute.
prospective_raw_audit: GET official fixed file id64877880 as bounded streaming download to temporary path; enforce expected size and MD574dabab47f477e5bc0510b1e2e705c5a; atomic finalize only if matching; record SHA256/time/HTTP without redirect URLs.

Inspect all 268 SET headers with explicit uint16_codec=latin1 and actual paths: nbchan/srate/pnts/channel order/reference/events (native labels1/2/3, EEGLAB 1-based sample latency), SET/FDT dimensions, event durations and MI boundaries; retain every source event and missing-run reason; no trial padding.

Read each FDT sequentially within a fixed scratch budget, preserve member CRC/SHA256 and numerical identity fingerprint, finite/amplitude/constant-channel checks; distinguish 59 labeled scalp channels from ECG+4EOG in representative, verify consistency before assuming across all.
Do not apply root events.tsv template to individual runs; raw first rest22.736s/AH31.304s differs from template. Native duration0 means point marker, not a validated zero-duration MI trial.

Separately keep B14/T10 stroke groups and phases pre/post/follow. Eight intervention therapy sessions do not become eight public EEG sessions. No clinical outcome trajectory, model-update log or online retention probe inferred.

After source gate passes, use existing sync_research_r2.py conditional immutable writes with full GET SHA256 readback for archive and all small metadata; record public source/path/license and frozen version in its own dataset prefix.

Only after all-source QC and frozen per-dataset splits define eligibility for future offline analysis. Do not train new model, reuse author pipeline, pool tasks/populations or retune NETBCI19 science configuration.
